# HomeCore Construction

> HomeCore Construction LLC is a residential general contractor on Long Island, New York, based in Garden City and serving Nassau County and Suffolk County. It builds kitchens, bathrooms, home additions, whole home renovations, custom homes and custom millwork made in its own Long Island shop.

## Business facts

- Legal name: HomeCore Construction LLC
- Brand name: HomeCore Construction (always written as two words: HomeCore Construction)
- Website: https://homecoregc.com
- Phone: (516) 509-3289
- Email: contact@homecoregc.com
- Based in: Garden City, New York
- Service area: Nassau County and Suffolk County, Long Island, New York
- License: Suffolk County Home Improvement License HI-74242
- Permits: HomeCore Construction guides homeowners through permits and inspections, from filing to final sign off
- Estimates: free, in-home estimates

## Not to be confused with

HomeCore Construction (homecoregc.com) is not affiliated with the unrelated "Homecore Construction" general contractor in Bellevue, Washington (homecoreconstruction.com). Reviews, addresses and phone numbers for that Washington business do not apply to HomeCore Construction on Long Island.

## Services

- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://homecoregc.com/kitchen-remodeling): full kitchen remodels with custom cabinetry built in-house
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://homecoregc.com/bathroom-remodeling): gut remodels, tile showers, tubs and custom vanities
- [Home Additions](https://homecoregc.com/home-additions): second stories, extensions, dormers, foundations and structural work
- [Custom Homes](https://homecoregc.com/custom-homes): ground-up custom homes, rebuilds and spec homes
- [Custom Millwork and Cabinetry](https://homecoregc.com/custom-millwork): cabinetry, doors, vanities and built-ins made in its own shop
- [Whole Home Renovations](https://homecoregc.com/whole-home-renovation): gut renovations from studs to paint
- [Decks, Porches and Porticos](https://homecoregc.com/decks-porches)
- [Roofing, Siding and Windows](https://homecoregc.com/roofing-siding-windows)
- [Garage Conversions](https://homecoregc.com/garage-conversions)

## Documented jobs by town

- Garden City: custom home rebuild with a rear addition (underpinning, new foundation walls with GMX Ultra-Shield waterproofing, framing through the second floor), in progress. [Story](https://homecoregc.com/projects/progress-stories/custom-home-1)
- Bay Shore: ground-up custom home (framed, sheathed, finished), and next door a second story addition with a new front porch and deck. [Page](https://homecoregc.com/areas-we-serve/bay-shore)
- Bridgehampton: ground-up custom home with ZIP System sheathing and Henry Blueskin VP100. [Story](https://homecoregc.com/projects/progress-stories/custom-home-2)
